name: Email to tasks
summary: Read new email to and from people on your board and propose contact notes and follow-up tasks.

routes.how: Install gog and sign in to the intended Gmail account
probe: import subprocess,json,sys; p=subprocess.run(["gog","auth","list","--json"],capture_output=True); d=json.loads(p.stdout) if p.returncode==0 else {}; sys.exit(not (d.get("accounts") if isinstance(d,dict) else d))

flow.title: Once a day
flow.text: Runs on the shared automation schedule.

flow.title: Read Gmail
flow.text: Read only, through your gog login, one or more named mailboxes. Only exact addresses of board contacts.

flow.title: Find new messages
flow.text: A small script lists new message IDs as hashes and skips spam, drafts, promotions and big lists. No AI, no email text stored.

flow.title: Find follow-ups
flow.text: An agent reads each matching message, checks what the board already has and spots clear next steps.

flow.title: Review Inbox
flow.text: Tasks and contact notes wait there as proposals. It never sends or changes email.

lookback_days.help: Days of mail the first run reads (1 to 90). Later runs continue from the last window.

max_recipients.help: Mail you sent to more people than this (To and Cc) counts as a list, not a personal exchange (1 to 100).

sources.help: gog account aliases to read, in order, comma-separated (e.g. personal,work; at most 3). Empty: gog's default account.

include_sent.help: Also find mail you sent to a board contact. Needs a gog that lists To and Cc; otherwise the check blocks with setup-missing:gog-recipients.
